units.source_text: 凡是见过源氏公子一面的人，看到他今天那种愁闷模样，

en.t: Anyone who had ever seen Prince Genji even once, seeing him looking so sorrowful today,

units.source_text: 没有一个不悲叹惋惜，何况平日经常伺候他的人。

en.t: could not help grieving and feeling pity, to say nothing of those who served him every day.

units.source_text: 连公子认也不认识的做粗工的老婆子和洗刷马桶的人，

en.t: Even old women who did rough labor and people who washed chamber pots, whom the prince did not even know,

units.source_text: 只因一向深蒙公子恩顾，也都以今后暂时见不到公子为恨。

en.t: because they had long received his generous kindness, all regretted that they would not be able to see him for a while.

units.source_text: 朝中百官，谁不重视此事？

en.t: Among all the officials at court, who did not regard this matter as grave?

units.source_text: 公子从七岁起就昼夜不离父皇左右，凡有奏请，无不照准。

en.t: From the age of seven, the prince had stayed by his imperial father's side day and night, and every petition he made was approved.

units.source_text: 因此百官无不仰仗公子鼎力，谁不感恩在心？

en.t: For that reason, all the officials had relied on the prince's powerful support; who did not feel gratitude in his heart?

units.source_text: 身份高贵的公卿、弁官之中，受恩者亦甚多。

en.t: Among the high-ranking nobles and benkan officials, there were also very many who had benefited from his favor.
As for those of lower rank, they were beyond counting.

units.source_text: 其中也有些人，并非不知恩德，只为目前权臣专横，不得不有所顾忌，

en.t: Among them were some who were not unaware of his kindness, but because the powerful ministers now acted so high-handedly, they had no choice but to be cautious,

units.source_text: 因而不敢亲近源氏公子。

en.t: and therefore did not dare to draw near to Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 总之，举世之人，无不痛惜源氏公子之离去。

en.t: In short, everyone in the world deeply lamented Prince Genji's departure.

units.source_text: 他们私下议论并怨恨有司之不公，但念：

en.t: They discussed it in private and resented the unfairness of the authorities, but thought:

units.source_text: 不顾自身利害而前去慰问，对源氏公子有何裨益？

en.t: What benefit would it bring Prince Genji if we ignored our own interests and went to console him?
And so they merely pretended not to know.

units.source_text: 源氏公子当此失意之时，感到人多冷酷无情，

en.t: At this time of disappointment, Prince Genji felt that most people were cold and heartless,
and everywhere he went, he sighed over the fickleness of the world.
